summary:
The trends category is the whole story right now — every rating shows an identical 14d 58-33 (64%) trend read, flagged HOT at +5.3 to +7.6 pts across R1-R4, and it pairs with sp for the best combo on the board at 58.0% (357-259, n=616). SP itself is scorching for R1/R2/R3 at 62%, 62%, and 59% over the last 14 with active 3W streaks on every rating, while bullpen is the mirror image — stuck at 52% or worse across the board with a 3L streak on all four ratings and an outright COLD flag on R4 (-5.7pts). If you're leaning on any rating today, lean where trends and sp agree and stay away from bullpen-driven signals entirely.

That trends+sp combo lines up cleanly with today's slate. CHC @ SDP is the strongest consensus play of the day, all four ratings on SDP with deltas from +2.09 to +2.42, and Gausman on the mound gives the sp signal real weight given its hot recent form. BOS @ NYY is next, full consensus on NYY (+1.44 to +2.08), with Max Fried starting — another spot where the hot sp trend supports the side. PHI @ ATL is a softer consensus lean on ATL (+0.72 to +1.08), thinner margin so treat it as a lower-confidence lean rather than a strong play. CHW @ HOU is the one flat spot — all four ratings agree on CHW but deltas are tiny and negative (-0.21 to -0.42), essentially a coin-flip signal, not a game to size up. Note also NYY as a team carries a mediocre 50% record when picked this season (22-22, strong plays -5.0u), so even with today's rating consensus on NYY, don't let the model's hot sp/trends form blind you to that team-specific softness — this is a spot to bet the signal, not blindly chase the team label.
